# Syracuse.com

> Syracuse.com is a local news and classified marketplace platform serving the Syracuse, NY region with advertising, job recruitment, and community classified listings.

Syracuse.com provides essential local services including a classifieds marketplace for pets, automotive, and real estate, along with a dedicated hiring platform for employers and job seekers in the Syracuse area. The site is operated by AdvanceLocal Agency and serves as a central hub for local commerce and employment opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Syracuse, NY
- Classifieds marketplace
- Local advertising
- Job postings
- Recruitment portal
- Classified listings
- Place ads
- Hiring platform
- Employer login
- Candidate management
- Real estate listings
- Automotive classifieds
- Pet classifieds

## Classifieds & Marketplace

- [Syracuse.com Classifieds](https://placead.syracuse.com/): Classifieds marketplace for Syracuse.com with pets, automotive, real estate listings and ad submission

## Recruitment & Hiring

- [Syracuse.com Hiring Portal](https://hiring.syracuse.com/): Recruitment platform for job postings, employer login, and candidate management
